summation.displayName: In the absence of sufficient EYA1-4 activity, APBB1 (FE65) b...
summation.text: In the absence of sufficient EYA1-4 activity, APBB1 (FE65) binds diphosphorylated H2AFX and recruits MAPK8 (JNK1) to H2AFX. This triggers pro-apoptotic signaling and targets the affected cell for apoptosis instead of DNA repair (Cook et al. 2009).
